title: Shared responsibility for EC2, RDS and Lambda

kcs.statement: With EC2, an IaaS service, the customer patches the guest operating system and applications and configures security groups, while AWS secures the physical host and hypervisor.

With Amazon RDS, a managed database, AWS patches the database engine and underlying operating system, while the customer manages database users and permissions, network access rules, encryption settings and public accessibility.
With AWS Lambda, AWS manages the servers, operating system and runtime patching, while the customer is responsible for function code, its dependencies, its IAM permissions and its data.
